focus: 以測深方量泥漿輸送與環境收支管理港池航道疏浚~Manage harbor dredging through sounding, volume, slurry transport and environmental accounting

units.anchor: 疏浚稜體與斷面~Dredging prism and sections
units.title: 疏浚稜體與斷面~Dredging prism and sections
units.mechanism: 航道挖方由既有海床和目標稜體之差形成，邊坡與局部淺點不能用單一平均深度取代。相鄰斷面梯形積分只在面積沿程近似線性時合理，曲率大時應加密；計量還須區分設計挖方、允許超挖及實際移除量，避免讓合約分類混入物理收支。 假設相鄰斷面挖方面積120與180m²、間距50m，V=(120+180)×50/2=7500m³；限線性面積變化。 ~Excavation is the difference between surveyed bed and a defined dredging prism; side slopes and local shoals cannot be replaced by one mean depth. Trapezoidal integration assumes approximately linear area variation between sections and needs refinement where curvature is large. Design volume, permitted overdepth and actual removal remain distinct quantities in the physical balance. Assume excavation areas120 and180m² separated by50m. V=(120+180)×50/2=7500m³, assuming linear area variation.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設相鄰斷面挖方面積120與180m²、間距50m，V=(120+180)×50/2=7500m³；限線性面積變化。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume excavation areas120 and180m² separated by50m. V=(120+180)×50/2=7500m³, assuming linear area variation.
units.verify: 繪出原床、設計底與邊坡交線，核對各斷面是否使用同一高程。加入中間剖面測試線性假設，並將超挖和不可測區獨立列帳，讓方量差能追溯到具體幾何。~Plot original bed, design bottom and side-slope intersections on a shared datum. Add an intermediate section to test linearity, and account for overdepth and unmeasured areas separately so volume differences remain traceable to explicit geometry.
units.failure: 斷面間藏有淺脊時梯形法會低估挖方，若把合約允許超挖全算成已挖則高估完成量。平均深度達到目標，也不能證明船舶通過路徑無淺點。~A hidden ridge between sections understates excavation, while treating all permitted overdepth as completed removal overstates progress. Adequate mean depth does not establish that the vessel route is free from controlling shallow features.
units.misconception: 航道平均深度達標就代表每個局部淺點都已移除。~Meeting average channel depth proves that every local controlling shoal has been removed.
units.practice: 繪出原床、設計底與邊坡交線，核對各斷面是否使用同一高程。加入中間剖面測試線性假設，並將超挖和不可測區獨立列帳，讓方量差能追溯到具體幾何。~Plot original bed, design bottom and side-slope intersections on a shared datum. Add an intermediate section to test linearity, and account for overdepth and unmeasured areas separately so volume differences remain traceable to explicit geometry.

units.anchor: 泥漿密度與濃度~Slurry density and concentration
units.title: 泥漿密度與濃度~Slurry density and concentration
units.mechanism: 泥漿混合密度可在兩相體積相加假設下推回固體體積濃度，但氣泡、鹽度與粒子密度變化會破壞簡單換算。質量濃度與體積濃度不是同一比例，需先定義量測對象；濃度提高也會改變流變和輸送阻力，不能只以濃泥漿代表高效作業。 假設泥漿1300、清水1000、顆粒2650kg/m³，Cv=(1300−1000)/(2650−1000)=0.1818；忽略含氣與體積非加成。 ~Under additive two-phase volumes, mixture density estimates solid volume concentration. Bubbles, salinity and varying grain density violate the simple conversion. Mass and volume concentration are different fractions and require explicit definitions. Higher concentration also changes rheology and resistance, so denser slurry does not by itself demonstrate efficient or sustainable pumping performance along the entire line. Assume mixture1300, water1000 and grains2650kg/m³. Cv=(1300−1000)/(2650−1000)=0.1818, excluding air and nonadditive volume effects.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設泥漿1300、清水1000、顆粒2650kg/m³，Cv=(1300−1000)/(2650−1000)=0.1818；忽略含氣與體積非加成。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mixture1300, water1000 and grains2650kg/m³. Cv=(1300−1000)/(2650−1000)=0.1818, excluding air and nonadditive volume effects.
units.verify: 比較線上密度計與乾固體採樣，核對水體鹽度和代表粒子密度。標明每份報表用質量或體積濃度，追蹤氣泡與分層造成的偏差，不用單點讀值代表整段輸送狀態。~Compare inline density with dry-solid samples, checking salinity and representative grain density. Label each report by mass or volume concentration and track air or stratification biases instead of treating a single reading as the state of the full pipeline.
units.failure: 吸入空氣會降低密度卻不等於固體供應下降，分層採樣則可能錯失底部高濃度。將兩種濃度百分比互換會使固體產量與負荷計算同時偏離實際。~Entrained air lowers density without necessarily reducing solid feed, and stratified samples miss concentrated bed material. Interchanging mass and volume percentages simultaneously corrupts estimates of solid production and the hydraulic burden on the system.
units.misconception: 固體質量百分比和固體體積百分比可以不加換算直接互用。~Solid mass percentage and solid volume percentage are interchangeable without conversion.
units.practice: 比較線上密度計與乾固體採樣，核對水體鹽度和代表粒子密度。標明每份報表用質量或體積濃度，追蹤氣泡與分層造成的偏差，不用單點讀值代表整段輸送狀態。~Compare inline density with dry-solid samples, checking salinity and representative grain density. Label each report by mass or volume concentration and track air or stratification biases instead of treating a single reading as the state of the full pipeline.

units.anchor: 乾固體生產率~Dry-solid production rate
units.title: 乾固體生產率~Dry-solid production rate
units.mechanism: 吸泥泵的總體積流量包含大量水，疏浚產量必須說明是泥漿、固體或原狀土量。沿管路濃度和流速需同步量測，平均值相乘在兩者相關變動時未必等於平均固體通量；生產紀錄也要分出停機與工作時間，不能把瞬時峰值當日產量。 假設泥漿Q=2m³/s、均勻Cv=0.15、顆粒2650kg/m³，乾固體通量ρsCvQ=795kg/s，1h為2862000kg。 ~Pump volume includes carrier water, so production must distinguish slurry, solids and in-situ sediment. Concentration and velocity require synchronized observations; multiplying separate means need not equal mean solid flux when they covary. Records must also separate downtime from pumping duration, since an instantaneous peak cannot be interpreted as achieved daily production or retained placement volume. Assume slurry Q=2m³/s,Cv=0.15 and grain density2650kg/m³. Dry-solid flux is795kg/s, giving2862000kg over1h of unchanged operation.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設泥漿Q=2m³/s、均勻Cv=0.15、顆粒2650kg/m³，乾固體通量ρsCvQ=795kg/s，1h為2862000kg。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume slurry Q=2m³/s,Cv=0.15 and grain density2650kg/m³. Dry-solid flux is795kg/s, giving2862000kg over1h of unchanged operation.
units.verify: 使用同步的流量和濃度時間序列積分固體量，將停機資料明確保留為零產量。以接收端乾固體抽樣作交叉檢查，說明管內暫存和輸送延遲，避免混淆兩端同時讀值。~Integrate synchronized discharge and concentration records, retaining downtime as zero production. Cross-check receiver dry-solid samples and describe pipe storage and transit delay so readings at the two ends are not incorrectly compared at identical timestamps.
units.failure: 只保留運轉時高濃度片段會高估整班產量，流量計與密度計時鐘偏移也會錯配脈動。到達填區的固體量不符時，需查暫存和洩漏而非修改帳面密度。~Selecting only high-concentration operating periods overstates shift production, and clock offsets mispair pulses. A receiver discrepancy requires investigation of storage and leakage rather than arbitrary adjustment of the density used in the accounting.
units.misconception: 泥漿流量全部等於真正挖出的乾固體體積流量。~The entire slurry discharge equals the actual excavated dry-solid volume flow.
units.practice: 使用同步的流量和濃度時間序列積分固體量，將停機資料明確保留為零產量。以接收端乾固體抽樣作交叉檢查，說明管內暫存和輸送延遲，避免混淆兩端同時讀值。~Integrate synchronized discharge and concentration records, retaining downtime as zero production. Cross-check receiver dry-solid samples and describe pipe storage and transit delay so readings at the two ends are not incorrectly compared at identical timestamps.

units.anchor: 管路摩擦水頭~Pipeline friction head
units.title: 管路摩擦水頭~Pipeline friction head
units.mechanism: 管路阻力消耗輸送能量，長度、直徑和速度影響不同，彎頭與高程則另有貢獻。清水達西式只作基準，含砂漿體可能沉積或表現非牛頓流變，不能沿用同一摩擦係數就宣稱可輸送；要把壓力觀測和材料狀態一起比較。 假設清水基準f=0.02、L=500m、D=0.50m、v=3m/s，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=9.174m；不含彎頭與漿體修正。 ~Pipeline resistance consumes energy, with distinct effects from length, diameter and speed; fittings and elevation add separate terms. A clear-water Darcy relation is only a baseline. Slurry can deposit or develop non-Newtonian behavior, so retaining one friction factor does not establish transportability. Pressure observations need interpretation together with concentration, grading and material condition. Assume a clear-water baseline f=0.02,L=500m,D=0.50m,v=3m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=9.174m, excluding fittings and slurry corrections.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設清水基準f=0.02、L=500m、D=0.50m、v=3m/s，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=9.174m；不含彎頭與漿體修正。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a clear-water baseline f=0.02,L=500m,D=0.50m,v=3m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=9.174m, excluding fittings and slurry corrections.
units.verify: 以相同高度基準畫沿管壓力線，核對壓力計位置、流速和內徑。比較清水試運與不同濃度資料，單獨列出局部損失及升高段，找出不能由基準摩擦解釋的壓降。~Plot the pressure line on a common elevation datum, checking gauge positions, velocity and internal diameter. Compare clear-water trials with different concentrations, listing fitting losses and rising sections separately to locate pressure drops unexplained by baseline friction.
units.failure: 管底沉積會縮小有效截面並增大阻力，壓力升高若只被當成流量增加可能延誤堵塞辨識。老化管徑和磨耗也會使原先水力曲線不再代表實際系統。~Bed deposition reduces effective area and increases resistance; interpreting rising pressure solely as increased flow can delay blockage detection. Aging geometry and wear also make the original hydraulic curve unrepresentative of the operating pipeline.
units.misconception: 清水管損公式無需任何修正就能保證高濃度泥漿可輸送。~An uncorrected clear-water friction formula guarantees transport of concentrated dredging slurry.
units.practice: 以相同高度基準畫沿管壓力線，核對壓力計位置、流速和內徑。比較清水試運與不同濃度資料，單獨列出局部損失及升高段，找出不能由基準摩擦解釋的壓降。~Plot the pressure line on a common elevation datum, checking gauge positions, velocity and internal diameter. Compare clear-water trials with different concentrations, listing fitting losses and rising sections separately to locate pressure drops unexplained by baseline friction.

units.anchor: 泵送能量收支~Pumping energy balance
units.title: 泵送能量收支~Pumping energy balance
units.mechanism: 水力功率代表流體得到的機械能，電功率還需除以泵與驅動效率，不能拿銘牌最大值代替工況。漿體密度、總水頭和流量必須來自同一時段，效率又隨運轉點改變；這項收支可診斷異常，但無法獨立決定設備選型或允許負載。 假設泥漿ρ=1300kg/m³、Q=2m³/s、總水頭20m、總效率0.70，Pin=ρgQH/η=728.7kW；效率固定示意。 ~Hydraulic power is mechanical energy delivered to the fluid, while input power additionally reflects pump and drive efficiency. Nameplate maximum is not an operating measurement. Density, total head and flow must describe the same period, and efficiency varies with operating point. This balance helps diagnose discrepancies but does not independently select machinery or establish its permissible load. Assume slurry1300kg/m³,Q=2m³/s,total head20m and total efficiency0.70. Pin=ρgQH/η=728.7kW with fixed illustrative efficiency.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設泥漿ρ=1300kg/m³、Q=2m³/s、總水頭20m、總效率0.70，Pin=ρgQH/η=728.7kW；效率固定示意。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume slurry1300kg/m³,Q=2m³/s,total head20m and total efficiency0.70. Pin=ρgQH/η=728.7kW with fixed illustrative efficiency.
units.verify: 同步記電力、流量、進出口總水頭和密度，區分瞬時與平均資料。用實測工況核對效率範圍，查找水頭漏項與機械損失，不能因公式吻合就忽略振動或材料輸送異常。~Record power, flow, inlet-outlet total head and density synchronously, distinguishing instantaneous and average records. Check efficiency at the measured operating point and investigate missing head terms or mechanical losses without overlooking vibration or transport abnormalities merely because arithmetic agrees.
units.failure: 用清水密度計算高濃度泥漿會低估功率，忽略吸入端速度和高程也會漏掉水頭。設備電力增加可能來自效率下降，並不一定代表固體生產增加。~Using clear-water density for concentrated slurry understates power, while omitted suction velocity and elevation miss head terms. Higher electrical consumption can result from declining efficiency rather than increased production of useful dry solids.
units.misconception: 泵的電力消耗增加就一定代表乾固體疏浚產量增加。~Increased pump electricity consumption always means increased dry-solid dredging production.
units.practice: 同步記電力、流量、進出口總水頭和密度，區分瞬時與平均資料。用實測工況核對效率範圍，查找水頭漏項與機械損失，不能因公式吻合就忽略振動或材料輸送異常。~Record power, flow, inlet-outlet total head and density synchronously, distinguishing instantaneous and average records. Check efficiency at the measured operating point and investigate missing head terms or mechanical losses without overlooking vibration or transport abnormalities merely because arithmetic agrees.

units.anchor: 聲波測深與基準~Acoustic depth and datum
units.title: 聲波測深與基準~Acoustic depth and datum
units.mechanism: 測深由聲波往返時間轉成距離，探頭吃水、船體升沉和潮位又把距離轉成海床高程。聲速剖面隨溫鹽改變，斜波束更容易出現折射偏差；只校正一個表面聲速不足以代表整個水柱，且各項修正必須保持相同符號約定。 假設垂直聲束、均勻聲速1500m/s、往返0.020s，探頭至床距15m；探頭在瞬時水面下1m時水深16m。 ~Sounding converts two-way travel time into range, then transducer draft, vessel motion and tide convert range into bed elevation. Temperature and salinity alter the sound-speed profile, particularly affecting oblique beams through refraction. A surface-only correction does not describe the whole water column, and every correction requires a consistent sign convention and reference frame. Assume a vertical beam, uniform sound speed1500m/s and two-way time0.020s. Transducer-bed range is15m;1m transducer draft gives water depth16m.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設垂直聲束、均勻聲速1500m/s、往返0.020s，探頭至床距15m；探頭在瞬時水面下1m時水深16m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a vertical beam, uniform sound speed1500m/s and two-way time0.020s. Transducer-bed range is15m;1m transducer draft gives water depth16m.
units.verify: 畫水面、探頭和海床的高程關係，逐項核對吃水、升沉與潮位符號。用獨立檢核線和聲速剖面測試折射，保留時鐘及姿態校準紀錄，避免只看點雲外觀平順。~Draw elevations of water surface, transducer and bed and verify draft, heave and tide signs. Test refraction with independent check lines and sound-speed profiles, retaining timing and attitude calibration instead of relying solely on smooth point-cloud appearance.
units.failure: 聲速設錯會造成整條測線深度偏差，吃水符號反轉又能讓誤差加倍。不同方向測線看似吻合時，仍可能共同受錯誤高程基準影響而一起偏移。~Incorrect sound speed biases the entire line, while reversed draft signs can amplify the error. Agreement between opposite survey directions can still conceal a shared incorrect vertical datum that shifts both sets of depths together.
units.misconception: 測得聲波往返距離後不必考慮探頭吃水與潮位修正。~Acoustic range alone gives charted bed elevation without draft or tide correction.
units.practice: 畫水面、探頭和海床的高程關係，逐項核對吃水、升沉與潮位符號。用獨立檢核線和聲速剖面測試折射，保留時鐘及姿態校準紀錄，避免只看點雲外觀平順。~Draw elevations of water surface, transducer and bed and verify draft, heave and tide signs. Test refraction with independent check lines and sound-speed profiles, retaining timing and attitude calibration instead of relying solely on smooth point-cloud appearance.

units.anchor: 測深不確定度預算~Sounding uncertainty budget
units.title: 測深不確定度預算~Sounding uncertainty budget
units.mechanism: 深度不確定度來自儀器、聲速、姿態和基準等分量，獨立隨機分量才能直接平方和。覆蓋率和小物體偵測又屬不同品質維度，精度高並不表示沒有漏測；合成預算用來理解誤差傳播，不是在未指定測量等級時自行宣告符合國際標準。 假設三個獨立零均值標準不確定度0.05、0.08、0.04m，合成σ=√(0.05²+0.08²+0.04²)=0.1025m。 ~Depth uncertainty combines instrument, sound-speed, attitude and reference contributions, with direct quadrature applying only to independent random components. Coverage and feature detection are separate quality dimensions: accurate points can still leave unseen obstructions. A synthetic budget illustrates propagation rather than claiming compliance with an international survey order that has not been specified and verified. Assume independent zero-mean standard uncertainties0.05,0.08 and0.04m. Combinedσ=√(0.05²+0.08²+0.04²)=0.1025m, excluding systematic bias.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設三個獨立零均值標準不確定度0.05、0.08、0.04m，合成σ=√(0.05²+0.08²+0.04²)=0.1025m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume independent zero-mean standard uncertainties0.05,0.08 and0.04m. Combinedσ=√(0.05²+0.08²+0.04²)=0.1025m, excluding systematic bias.
units.verify: 將標準不確定度、偏差及信賴界限分欄，說明每個分量是否相關。另查測線覆蓋與物體偵測證據，把品質要求連回調查用途，避免以單一平方和取代整體測量驗證。~Separate standard uncertainty, bias and confidence limits and identify correlations between components. Check coverage and feature-detection evidence independently, linking requirements to intended use rather than replacing complete survey verification with one combined quadrature value.
units.failure: 相關的潮位和基準誤差被假設獨立會低估不確定度，未測間隙中的石塊更不在預算內。漂亮的精度數字無法補救航道關鍵區沒有資料的問題。~Assuming independence between correlated tide and datum errors understates uncertainty, while a rock in an unsurveyed gap is absent from the budget entirely. Impressive precision cannot compensate for missing observations in controlling navigation areas.
units.misconception: 測深標準不確定度很小就表示所有航道障礙物都被找到。~Small sounding uncertainty proves that every channel obstruction has been detected.
units.practice: 將標準不確定度、偏差及信賴界限分欄，說明每個分量是否相關。另查測線覆蓋與物體偵測證據，把品質要求連回調查用途，避免以單一平方和取代整體測量驗證。~Separate standard uncertainty, bias and confidence limits and identify correlations between components. Check coverage and feature-detection evidence independently, linking requirements to intended use rather than replacing complete survey verification with one combined quadrature value.

units.anchor: 船底淨空分項~Under-keel clearance components
units.title: 船底淨空分項~Under-keel clearance components
units.mechanism: 航道水深與船舶吃水差只是靜態淨空，航行時還有船體動態下沉、波浪運動及量測餘量。各項需求可能相關且受場址限制，教學減法僅用來顯示預算組成；不能將結果當作船舶通行批准，真正操航需依權責單位規定和即時條件。 假設可用水深15m、吃水13m、動態下沉0.5m、波動需求0.4m、量測餘量0.2m，剩餘示意淨空0.9m。 ~Depth minus draft is only static clearance. Vessel squat, wave motion and measurement allowances affect the available margin during navigation. Demands may be correlated and site-dependent, so this arithmetic merely exposes budget components. It is not a transit approval; actual navigation depends on the responsible authority, vessel characteristics and contemporaneous conditions rather than this illustrative calculation. Assume depth15m,draft13m,squat0.5m,wave demand0.4m and survey allowance0.2m. Illustrative residual clearance is0.9m, not permission to transit.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設可用水深15m、吃水13m、動態下沉0.5m、波動需求0.4m、量測餘量0.2m，剩餘示意淨空0.9m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume depth15m,draft13m,squat0.5m,wave demand0.4m and survey allowance0.2m. Illustrative residual clearance is0.9m, not permission to transit.
units.verify: 明列水位時刻、吃水來源與各需求的定義，檢查是否有重複或漏計。將示意預算與權責單位的場址方法分開保存，核對船型、航速及波向適用性，不以平均水深代替最淺點。~Record water-level time, draft source and each demand definition, checking duplication and omission. Keep this illustration separate from the authority’s site method, verify vessel, speed and wave-direction applicability, and use controlling shallows rather than average depth.
units.failure: 忽略動態下沉會在靜態淨空看似充裕時低估碰底可能，混用潮位時刻也會錯估可用水深。多個保守餘量重複扣除則可能讓分析失去可追溯性。~Ignoring squat can understate bottom-contact exposure despite apparently adequate static clearance, and mismatched tide times misstate depth. Duplicating conservative allowances creates the opposite error and makes the resulting assessment difficult to audit or interpret.
units.misconception: 靜態水深大於吃水就代表任何航速與波況都可以通航。~Water depth exceeding draft permits navigation at every speed and wave condition.
units.practice: 明列水位時刻、吃水來源與各需求的定義，檢查是否有重複或漏計。將示意預算與權責單位的場址方法分開保存，核對船型、航速及波向適用性，不以平均水深代替最淺點。~Record water-level time, draft source and each demand definition, checking duplication and omission. Keep this illustration separate from the authority’s site method, verify vessel, speed and wave-direction applicability, and use controlling shallows rather than average depth.

units.anchor: 循環時間與產量~Cycle time and production
units.title: 循環時間與產量~Cycle time and production
units.mechanism: 耙吸船或抓斗作業有挖取、移動、卸料及等待階段，只有完整循環才能換算持續產量。有效利用率需明確說明是否已包含等待，避免重複扣除；料艙容量亦非原狀土方，材料膨鬆與含水會使不同產量報表無法直接比較。 假設每循環合格完成方600m³、循環時間40min且另計可用率0.75，平均600×60/40×0.75=675m³/h。 ~A dredging cycle includes excavation, travel, unloading and waiting, so sustainable production requires the complete cycle. Utilization must state whether waiting is already included to avoid double deductions. Hopper capacity is also not in-situ soil volume; bulking and water content make reports with different volume definitions unsuitable for direct comparison across equipment or shifts. Assume completed acceptable volume600m³ per40min cycle and separately defined availability0.75. Mean production=600×60/40×0.75=675m³/h.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每循環合格完成方600m³、循環時間40min且另計可用率0.75，平均600×60/40×0.75=675m³/h。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume completed acceptable volume600m³ per40min cycle and separately defined availability0.75. Mean production=600×60/40×0.75=675m³/h.
units.verify: 用原始時戳分解循環階段，標明可用率排除或納入的停機原因。核對完成方是否已由測量確認，並比較多個班次的分布，不以最快一趟或料艙名義容量代表長期績效。~Use raw timestamps to separate cycle phases and define included downtime in availability. Check whether completed volume is survey-confirmed and compare distributions across shifts rather than representing long-term performance by the fastest trip or nominal hopper capacity.
units.failure: 將等待時間納入循環又乘含等待的可用率會重複扣減，反之漏記卸料與移航則過度樂觀。容量達標而底部仍留淺點，也不能視為合格完成方。~Counting waiting in both cycle time and availability double-reduces output, while omitting travel and unloading inflates it. A full hopper does not represent acceptable completed excavation if controlling shallow patches remain on the bed.
units.misconception: 每次滿艙容量乘理論班次就是已驗收的航道完成方量。~Full hopper capacity times theoretical cycles equals accepted completed channel excavation.
units.practice: 用原始時戳分解循環階段，標明可用率排除或納入的停機原因。核對完成方是否已由測量確認，並比較多個班次的分布，不以最快一趟或料艙名義容量代表長期績效。~Use raw timestamps to separate cycle phases and define included downtime in availability. Check whether completed volume is survey-confirmed and compare distributions across shifts rather than representing long-term performance by the fastest trip or nominal hopper capacity.

units.anchor: 回流水固體平衡~Return-water solids balance
units.title: 回流水固體平衡~Return-water solids balance
units.mechanism: 放置區回流水可能攜帶細料，輸入和排出通量需以同一時段及乾固體定義比較。截留比例只說明材料收支，不能替代水質與生態評估；沉積暫存和再懸浮也會改變短期結果，因此要避免把短時間高截留率解釋為長期永久固定。 假設乾固體輸入100kg/s、回流水2m³/s且固體0.5kg/m³，輸出1kg/s，當期截留率99%；不代表水質合格。 ~Return water can carry fines out of a placement area, so input and output fluxes require matching periods and dry-solid definitions. Retention describes material accounting rather than water-quality or ecological acceptability. Temporary storage and resuspension alter short-term results, meaning a high measured fraction cannot demonstrate permanent confinement or the absence of downstream effects. Assume dry-solid input100kg/s and return water2m³/s at0.5kg/m³. Export is1kg/s and period retention99%, not water-quality compliance.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾固體輸入100kg/s、回流水2m³/s且固體0.5kg/m³，輸出1kg/s，當期截留率99%；不代表水質合格。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry-solid input100kg/s and return water2m³/s at0.5kg/m³. Export is1kg/s and period retention99%, not water-quality compliance.
units.verify: 同步量入料與回流水濃度流量，確認排水口是否全部納入，並扣除可辨識的原床再懸浮。用分期地形和乾固體存量核對積分收支，將環境暴露與截留率分開呈現。~Measure input and all return outlets synchronously and account for identifiable native-bed resuspension. Check integrated fluxes against repeated terrain and dry-solid storage observations, presenting environmental exposure separately from the numerical fraction retained during the selected period.
units.failure: 少量流失若集中在敏感時段仍可能重要，漏掉旁通排水會使截留率虛高。存量變化不符時只改濃度平均值，會掩蓋未量到的出口或暫存延遲。~A small exported fraction can matter during sensitive periods, and omitted bypass outlets inflate retention. Adjusting mean concentration to close a storage discrepancy conceals unmeasured paths or delays instead of explaining the actual material balance.
units.misconception: 九成九固體截留率可以自動證明回流水符合所有環境要求。~Ninety-nine-percent solid retention automatically proves that return water meets every environmental requirement.
units.practice: 同步量入料與回流水濃度流量，確認排水口是否全部納入，並扣除可辨識的原床再懸浮。用分期地形和乾固體存量核對積分收支，將環境暴露與截留率分開呈現。~Measure input and all return outlets synchronously and account for identifiable native-bed resuspension. Check integrated fluxes against repeated terrain and dry-solid storage observations, presenting environmental exposure separately from the numerical fraction retained during the selected period.

title: 港池航道疏浚~Harbor-basin and navigation-channel dredging
summary: 以測深方量泥漿輸送與環境收支管理港池航道疏浚。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。~Manage harbor dredging through sounding, volume, slurry transport and environmental accounting. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
history: 港灣疏浚同時包含航行幾何、材料移動與環境介面，不能只用挖泥船大小描述技術演進。二〇一五年工兵團手冊整理新挖、維護和疏浚物管理；二〇二二年薩凡納港官方紀錄明確指加深疏浚部分完成，而非所有配套同日完工。國際水道組織二〇二四年第六點二版標準提供品質與用途框架，不等於設備操作說明。本課另以巴爾的摩航道材料進入波普勒島復育的歷程說明來源與去向必須連結。所有設備、方量和淨空數字都是合成練習，不是上述專案的實際作業資料。~Harbor dredging combines navigation geometry, material movement and environmental interfaces rather than simply the size of dredging machinery. The2015 USACE manual addresses new work, maintenance and material management. The2022 Savannah release specifically records completion of deepening dredging, not all associated works on the same date. IHO’s2024 edition6.2.0 provides survey-quality and intended-use context rather than equipment instructions. Baltimore-channel material used at Poplar Island separately illustrates the link between source and destination. Equipment, volume and clearance values throughout the course are synthetic exercises, not operating records from these projects.
example: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設相鄰斷面挖方面積120與180m²、間距50m，V=(120+180)×50/2=7500m³；限線性面積變化。假設第二斷面面積由180增10%至198m²，其餘不變，方量由7500增至7950m³，只增加6%；不是任何航道加深都按同一百分比變化。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。~This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume excavation areas120 and180m² separated by50m. V=(120+180)×50/2=7500m³, assuming linear area variation. Increasing the second section area from180 to198m² by10% with everything else fixed raises volume from7500 to7950m³, only6%; this is not a universal channel-deepening response. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設相鄰斷面挖方面積120與180m²、間距50m，V=(120+180)×50/2=7500m³；限線性面積變化。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume excavation areas120 and180m² separated by50m. V=(120+180)×50/2=7500m³, assuming linear area variation.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設泥漿1300、清水1000、顆粒2650kg/m³，Cv=(1300−1000)/(2650−1000)=0.1818；忽略含氣與體積非加成。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mixture1300, water1000 and grains2650kg/m³. Cv=(1300−1000)/(2650−1000)=0.1818, excluding air and nonadditive volume effects.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設泥漿Q=2m³/s、均勻Cv=0.15、顆粒2650kg/m³，乾固體通量ρsCvQ=795kg/s，1h為2862000kg。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume slurry Q=2m³/s,Cv=0.15 and grain density2650kg/m³. Dry-solid flux is795kg/s, giving2862000kg over1h of unchanged operation.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設清水基準f=0.02、L=500m、D=0.50m、v=3m/s，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=9.174m；不含彎頭與漿體修正。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a clear-water baseline f=0.02,L=500m,D=0.50m,v=3m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=9.174m, excluding fittings and slurry corrections.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設泥漿ρ=1300kg/m³、Q=2m³/s、總水頭20m、總效率0.70，Pin=ρgQH/η=728.7kW；效率固定示意。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume slurry1300kg/m³,Q=2m³/s,total head20m and total efficiency0.70. Pin=ρgQH/η=728.7kW with fixed illustrative efficiency.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設垂直聲束、均勻聲速1500m/s、往返0.020s，探頭至床距15m；探頭在瞬時水面下1m時水深16m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a vertical beam, uniform sound speed1500m/s and two-way time0.020s. Transducer-bed range is15m;1m transducer draft gives water depth16m.
